content.title: Petrobras Expands Natural Gas Imports with New Authorization From ANP
content.summary: PBR gets ANP approval to import up to 20 million cubic meters per day of Bolivian gas for two years, expanding supply via Caceres and Gasbol.

content.title: Chevron Extracts First Oil From South N'dola Platform Offshore Angola
content.summary: CVX starts production at Angola's South N'dola field, using existing infrastructure to boost output, jobs and support oil and LNG growth.

content.title: Petrobras Awards $150M Long-Term RSV Contract to DOF Group
content.summary: PBR awards DOF Group a $150 million four-year contract for the Skandi Commander, boosting offshore ops with advanced ROV and AUV tech starting 2027.

content.title: Still Holding Delek US Stock? Here's Why That's Justified
content.summary: DK benefits from structural improvements, a solid balance sheet and growth in sour gas but faces challenges from rising costs, corporate complexity and fluctuating refining margins.

content.title: Chevron and Frontera Sign $120M Prepayment and Commercial Agreement
content.summary: CVX's unit locks in a long-term crude supply from Frontera Energy through a deal worth up to $120 million, starting with an $80 million prepayment.

content.title: Suncor Energy Stock: Not a Buy Yet, But Still Worth Holding On
content.summary: SU's integrated model, strong downstream utilization, prudent balance sheet management, record performance, and growth potential make it a prime investment opportunity with solid returns.

content.title: Does Imperial Oil's Stability Make It a Wise Hold Right Now?
content.summary: IMO's partnership with ExxonMobil and cost-saving efforts support growth, but high capital spending, energy transition risks, and commodity price volatility are concerns.

content.title: Petrobras Grants Final Investment for Sergipe Deepwater Project Module 2
content.summary: Petrobras approves the final investment decision for the SEAP II deepwater project, opening a new offshore production frontier in Brazil's Northeast.

content.title: Petrobras and OceanPact Sign $590M Deals for Offshore Services
content.summary: PBR and OceanPact sign $590 million ROSV charter deals, reinforcing their focus on offshore safety, maintenance, and subsea performance.

content.title: Shell and INEOS Confirm Major Oil Discovery in the Gulf of America
content.summary: SHEL and INEOS Energy announce a major Nashville oil discovery, with a potential Appomattox tie-back supporting long-term Gulf energy security.
